title: [DECISION] DigestInfo DER prefix hardcoded, not constructed at runtime
description: wolfssl_rsa.c hardcodes digestinfo_sha256/384/512_prefix as static const u8 arrays. Alternative would be runtime DER construction using asn_public.h helpers. Hardcoded is better: the prefix for each hash is fixed (RFC 8017 §9.2), compile-time verifiable, and avoids any DER construction error path. The test vectors in rsa.h verify end-to-end correctness. Correct choice.
